digest.component_or_area: store write seam and event validation
propositions: Event bodies containing live credentials (Anthropic, GitHub PAT, Google, Jira, OpenAI, PyPI) are accepted and persisted by the store with no content screening, allowing a single comment to wedge the entire shared tickets branch when GitHub push protection rejects the push.

The write path has multiple seams: append_event, txn/delete cores, and inbound_translate (Jira reconciliation), so a screen at append_event alone leaves credentials pasted into Jira comments able to reproduce the exact outage.

Refused writes must not echo secret values into exception messages, logs, stderr, or on-disk bytes, and must name the matched family and field location so overrides are informed choices rather than blind retries.
Benign look-alike text (truncated placeholders like sk-ant-api03-..., regex literals, prose enumerating patterns) must not be refused so the screen is safe to leave on by default.

The refusal seam is _seam.finalize_event, which all four writers (append_event, txn cores, delete cores, inbound_translate) route through; inbound_translate is changed to call the seam rather than its halves to prevent bypass.

A force override (--allow-secret-pattern=<reason>) allows refused writes for all CLI verbs, records the reason and bypassed families on the event for auditability, and is excluded from the MCP tool surface.
